scripts/tests/live-fire-render-accountin: Not an independent gate: it is the companion can-fail proof named by vitest-guard::packages/core/src/__tests__/memory-render-accounting-drift-guard.test.ts, and it IS executed on every sweep through that gate (the live-fire-npm-script-portability-guard.sh and live-fire-foreign-sweep-guard.sh precedents). Registering it a second time as self-proving would run it twice, and it plants into the REAL source tree - two concurrent plants of the same two files would race and restore each other's bytes, which is exactly the measurement-tool exclusivity hazard. Its own can-fail behaviour is proven by construction: every plant demands RED for its OWN declared reason and the run FAILS if a plant leaves the suite GREEN, which is how it caught a dead guard on its first execution.
